'''Smoulders''' is a [[pyrefiend]] mini-boss found within the [[Dragonkin Laboratory]] elite dungeon. The mini-boss is located in the second part of the dungeon, after [[Astellarn]], at the first group of Lava strykewyrms. It later returns as [[Smoulders, the Revenger]] in [[The Zamorakian Undercity]] Elite Dungeon.

In Story mode its health is reduced by 50% and its damage output is reduced by 90%. Just like in the Zamorakian Undercity, he attacks exclusively with magic auto-attacks.
